_provenance.what: One fresh reaver run per run schemaVersion, seed 0x10a5, created with that ref's createRunState and written by that ref's saveRun into a memory storage; `bytes` is the value it put under sote_run_v1. The ref is the first-parent commit on dev immediately before the merge that bumped RUN_SCHEMA_VERSION past this version — the last tree that wrote it.
_provenance.method: git archive <ref> src, then import that tree's content/index.js, model/registries.js, model/state.js, engine/save.js and engine/rng.js and call createRunState({ seed: 0x10a5, classId: "reaver", registries }) then saveRun(run, createRng(seed)).
_provenance.midRun: `midRun` holds MID-RUN saves, keyed by schemaVersion, captured at the same ref as that version's fresh entry (git archive <ref> src) and advanced with that tree's own functions before its saveRun: createRunState({ seed: 0x10a5, classId: "reaver", registries }); startClimb's buildActMap(registries, rng, seatAtTier(run.seatOrder, 1), 1, null, { history: run.history }) on createRng(0x10a5); main.js's ?shotWalk=4 walk (lowest-numbered `next` from the lowest start id, 4 nodes, setting mapNodeId, floor and path); cinders += 1000, then two shrine purchases applyLevelUp(registries, run, 'strength', { pointsPerLevel: 1 }) as ui/screens/rest.js does (levelUps 2); hp -= 7; then saveRun(run, rng). No combatEntered: a committed combat snapshot comes from the combat engine mid-turn, which a model-level capture cannot produce without hand-building it.
